limits: One shared M5, pinned preview and cached local DB row; no enforced CPU/RAM budget.
Main: each worker can open 10 DB connections. Fixed-total control: 12 configured across all workers, with observed counts retained.
App memory is the sum of process physical footprints, not uniquely occupied OS RAM or an enforced packing test.
PostgreSQL process footprint sums can include shared accounting; do not turn their sum into machine-wide unique bytes.
CPU percentages are process CPU seconds / elapsed seconds; 100% is one core, and DB CPU is separate.
Four repetitions, equal cell counts and rotated/reversed positions; not a complete nine-position Latin square.
Same-host clients and DB can constrain scaling. Every request count is checked work, not maximum independent server capacity.
